title: TrainerOS Backend contract definitions — unimplemented draft

LoginAttempt.description: Native return_uri skips manual code and requires a browser-only handoff_token at claim. Without return_uri, verification_code is an interim explicit device confirmation; never auto-submit it.

SessionTokens.description: Secret host-only response; never log or expose to games.

ReauthGrant.description: One-shot grant bound to actor, current session and sensitive operation.

RecoveryCodes.description: One-time secret delivery to shell. Hashes only at rest; never game-visible.

RecoveryBegin.description: Binds a fresh provider flow. Code alone does not return a session.

AvatarRecipe.description: Preserves existing SDK v1 recipe verbatim. Selections map future inventory; no local paths.

AvatarWrite.description: Cloud storage of existing SDK recipe; wire adapter must preserve local avatar contract.

EvidenceChunk.description: Decode <=16384 bytes; fixed offsets and total length checked semantically.

Submission.description: No caller-selected player, score, verified flag or reward; derived by validator.

CompetitionEntry.description: All roster members must independently consent; delegation validated server-side.

ProviderEvent.description: Internal normalized adapter output, never an unverified public webhook body.

PolicyGate.description: References reviewed server-owned policy; not executable config.

SdkBoardQuery.description: cursor and around_self cannot be combined; server/host semantic check
